verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub README lists "Typo Tolerance" (and "Exact Match") as a first-party feature, so fuzzy matching is a documented capability. The evidence is only a bare feature-list mention, with nothing on how it behaves by default or how to configure it. Missing for 10: confirmation that typo tolerance is on out of the box, documented tunable rules (tolerance/edit distance, per-field or term-length thresholds, prefix vs. fuzzy behavior), in-depth docs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, searches tolerate typos and misspellings out of the box, with tunable rules for when and how fuzzy matching applies
